headline: A still Saturday: no scored AI news
body: A completely quiet day. No events were scored, so the only movement came from earlier stories fading slightly; no ending moved by more than 0.02. The board still reflects Friday's Pentagon AI deals, which left Horizon Balance at its lowest reading so far; it now stands at +1.27.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Protector God -0.02 and Enslaved God -0.02.
